programme.title: Kuku Mathur Ki Jhand Ho Gayee
programme.desc: A film about a young man named Kuku who dreams of becoming a successful entrepreneur. When he gets a job at a wedding planning company, he sees it as his ticket to the good life. programme.title: Toonpur Ka Superr Hero
programme.desc: The world is in chaos as there is a constant quarrel between Devtoons, good cartoons, and Toonasurs, bad cartoons. Thereafter, Devtoons decide to abduct Aditya, a superhero, to save them.

programme.title: Baghban
programme.desc: It tells the story of Raj and Pooja, a couple married for 40 years, who are forced to live apart after retirement when their four sons refuse to care for them together.

programme.title: Hum To Mohabbat Karega
programme.desc: To pursue his love interest, TV reporter Geeta, Raju misleads the police with false clues during a murder investigation. His lies soon land him in trouble with the police and the mafia.

programme.title: Astitva
programme.desc: The movie follows the story of Aditi, a devoted wife, who discovers her husband's infidelity. As she confronts her husband and delves deeper into the truth, she begins to question her own identity and place in society.
